Scale expansion that makes categories tile a grid panel exactly

Source: R/plot_size.R
grid_expansion.Rd

A discrete scale of n categories spans 1 to n; expanding it by half a category on each side makes it span n units, so that each category gets exactly the `cell` size given to grid_panel_size. (ggplot2's default of 0.6 would make cells slightly smaller than asked.)

Usage

grid_expansion()

Value

An expansion vector for the `expand` argument of a discrete scale
